candidate.title: Sparse autoencoders reveal organized biological knowledge but minimal regulatory logic in single-cell foundation models: a comparative atlas of Geneformer and scGPT
candidate.abstract: Background: Single-cell foundation models such as Geneformer and scGPT encode rich biological information, but whether this includes causal regulatory logic rather than statistical co-expression remains unclear. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can resolve superposition in neural networks by decomposing dense activations into interpretable features, yet they have not been systematically applied to biological foundation models. Results: We trained TopK SAEs on residual stream activations from all layers of Geneformer V2-316M (18 layers, d=1152) and scGPT whole-human (12 layers, d=512), producing atlases of 82525 and 24527 features, respectively. Both atlases confirm massive superposition, with 99.8 percent of features invisible to SVD. Systematic characterization reveals rich biological organization: 29 to 59 percent of features annotate to Gene Ontology, KEGG, Reactome, STRING, or TRRUST, with U-shaped layer profiles reflecting hierarchical abstraction. Features organize into co-activation modules (141 in Geneformer, 76 in scGPT), exhibit causal specificity (median 2.36x), and form cross-layer information highways (63 to 99.8 percent). When tested against genome-scale CRISPRi perturbation data, only 3 of 48 transcription factors (6.2 percent) show regulatory-target-specific feature responses. A multi-tissue control yields marginal improvement (10.4 percent, 5 of 48 TFs), establishing model representations as the bottleneck. Conclusions: These models have internalized organized biological knowledge, including pathway membership, protein interactions, functional modules, and hierarchical abstraction, yet they encode minimal causal regulatory logic. We release both feature atlases as interactive web platforms enabling exploration of more than 107000 features across 30 layers of two leading single-cell foundation models.

panel.reason: SAE解析基础模型调控逻辑，批判性可解释性研究。
稀疏自编码器剖析基础模型调控逻辑，批判性机制解读。

extraction.method: TopK稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征图谱
extraction.data: Geneformer V2-316M与scGPT全人模型各层激活
extraction.scenario: 机制可解释性比较分析
extraction.results: 生成82525与24527个特征；99.8%特征SVD不可见；29–59%注释到通路；仅3/48（6.2%）TF显示调控特异性，多组织对照10.4%
extraction.availability: 两个特征图谱以交互式网页平台公开
extraction.limitations: 模型表示是瓶颈，调控逻辑编码极少
extraction.summary: 用TopK稀疏自编码器对Geneformer与scGPT各层残差流激活训练，构建特征图谱。系统刻画特征注释、共激活模块、因果特异性与跨层信息通路。发现模型内化了有组织的生物学知识，但几乎不含因果调控逻辑，仅6.2%转录因子显示调控靶标特异性响应。
